findings.highlight: kani-tama bowl is ready on the table.
findings.evidenceJa: かに玉丼が三人分並んでいる。
findings.governingReading: Three servings of kani-tama rice bowl are lined up on the table.
findings.explanation: The singular English omits both the count and the visible arrangement.

findings.governingReading: Tendon—a tempura rice bowl—is another example.
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces tempura with the unrelated teriyaki preparation.

findings.evidenceJa: 三者三様のお辞儀をして
findings.governingReading: The three diners each bow in their own distinct way.
findings.explanation: The individualized household gesture becomes one undifferentiated collective bow.

findings.highlight: Kani-tama is just a variant of an omelet.
findings.evidenceJa: かに玉とは、その玉子焼きの上級職だ。
findings.governingReading: Kani-tama is the advanced job class of an omelet.
findings.explanation: This second occurrence again deletes the game-system mechanism, and “just a variant” actively normalizes the joke.

findings.evidenceJa: いたずらにマスター捜しをする
findings.governingReading: searching for Masters to no purpose or recklessly
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces futility and tactical waste with a relaxed pace.

findings.evidenceJa: 無駄な時間は使えません。
findings.explanation: The English changes objective waste into a question of leisurely manner.

findings.governingReading: They crossed hands in a sparring bout.
findings.explanation: The mutual test of skill becomes generic training and gains the unsupported minimizer “a bit.”

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと向き合うまで
findings.governingReading: until Shirou actually faced Saber directly
findings.explanation: The English makes the realization depend specifically on fighting her rather than confronting the reality of her ability.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーがその気になって相手をしてくれれば
findings.governingReading: if Saber becomes serious and agrees to face him as his opponent
findings.explanation: Her willingness and role as a serious opponent become only intensity of instruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 壁に立てかけてある竹刀
findings.governingReading: the bamboo sword propped against the wall
findings.explanation: The English changes the object’s spatial relation and drops that it is leaning ready at hand.

findings.evidenceJa: たっぷり稽古を付けて貰お
findings.governingReading: have Saber give him a full four hours of instruction
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou the unmarked agent of his own training and replaces the teacher-pupil construction with an idiom.

findings.governingReading: No questions or argument are permitted.
findings.explanation: The source cuts off all debate; the English politely objects only to excuses.
